invariant: Evidence-lane concurrency is bounded by DECLARED resource limits rather than by however many lanes happen to exist; mandatory work has budget priority over optional work; and every lane records what it consumed.
precedent: Stage 4 already sizes its own concurrency from a measured resource (orchestrate_release.mjs validator_concurrency, by workbook bytes). This asset is the same convention for evidence lanes, moved out of a ternary and into a declaration two runtimes can read.

worker_reservation.note: One core and 1.5 GiB per concurrent lane worker; one core and 1 GiB held back for the controller process itself and its node parent.

budget_priority.mandatory_reserve_source: STAGE_FLOOR_MS x the mandatory stages still downstream of the evidence half (decisions, build_checks, review, delivery, stage-4 outer) = STAGE_FLOOR_STAGE_COUNT - 2
budget_priority.note: Optional work draws only on the surplus above the mandatory reserve. An optional grant that would fall below optional_floor_ms is zero: the lane is not started, and its fault containment closes it at zero authority. Mandatory work is never reduced below mandatory_floor_ms and is never starved.

budget_clock.note: P6.1's one persisted monotonic run clock is READ here and never written. Absence of a ledger means the declared lane budgets apply unchanged.
